questions.prompt: How did Aiden and Betty record the crystals growing?
choices: with a video and a song
questions.evidenceText: Aiden took a photograph and Betty added a mark to her chart. Then Mum put the jar back on the shelf, and everyone washed their hands.

questions.prompt: Why did the judges stay so long at their project?
choices: The crystal jar was difficult to open.
Aiden asked them to wait for Socks.
Betty explained what happened and why.
questions.answer: Betty explained what happened and why.
questions.rationale: The passage says the judges stayed a long time because Betty could explain what had happened and why, which directly links her explanation to their long visit.
questions.evidenceText: The judges spent a very long time with Aiden and Betty's crystals — because Betty could explain not just what had happened but why, which turned out to be the whole point of the exercise.

questions.prompt: What important idea did Aiden record after the fair?
choices: Experiments should be fair and safe.
questions.answer: Experiments should be fair and safe.
questions.evidenceText: That evening, Aiden added a new page to his field notebook. He wrote down six things that make an experiment fair and safe.
